patent.title: Apparatus for virtual golf simulation providing amendment to decreasing rate of ball flight distance and method for the same
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-12. Single-patent 특허법원 2021나1510 damages. Do not conflate with other Golfzon screen-golf patents.

knowledge_origin.description: Golfzon Co., Ltd. assignee; inventorship Lee/Lee/Song; corporate screen-golf RD assumed.

technology.problem: Make virtual golf simulation more realistic by amending ball flight-distance decrease rate based on fairway vs trouble mat regions.
technology.mechanism: Sensing device + image processor + controller that adjusts simulated ball flight distance decrease rate according to mat region (fairway/trouble) conditions.

value_carriers.name: KakaoVX/SGM accused screen-golf simulators (products J/K/L)
value_carriers.description: 특허법원 found products J/K/L infringe KR101031432 claim 1; injunction + destruction + damages ordered.

value_metrics.note: Single-patent Art.128⑦ (7% contribution). Dispute-specific; not intrinsic price.

gaps.description: Damages are litigation-context (Art.128⑦ discretion, 7% contribution); not a market license schedule.
